n4dadc13f03.headline: Millat Tractors to challenge FBR’s Rs18bn sales tax demand
n4dadc13f03.summary: Millat Tractors Limited, one of Pakistan's leading tractor manufacturers, has rebuked the Federal Board of Revenue over a Rs18 billion sales tax demand. The company says it will challenge the demand.
n4dadc13f03.why: Millat Tractors is a listed Pakistani tractor maker, and large tax disputes can affect its earnings and cash flow.

nf7975dcb67.headline: South Korea's exports of gasoline, diesel hit record high in 2024
nf7975dcb67.summary: Gasoline and diesel exports by South Korea's major refiners hit a record last year. Over 50 percent of imported crude oil was shipped overseas after refining in the country, according to data released Sunday.
nf7975dcb67.why: South Korea is a major refining hub, so its product export volumes affect Asian diesel and gasoline supply.

n3a0f4e86f5.headline: Ghana consumer inflation slows to 23.5% year-on-year in January
n3a0f4e86f5.summary: Ghana's consumer inflation dipped to 23.5% year-on-year in January from 23.8% in December, the statistics service said. The decline was driven by a slowdown in non-food inflation.
n3a0f4e86f5.why: Inflation data guides Bank of Ghana interest rate decisions and influences the cedi and local bond yields.

nacbebd0ac5.headline: Trump to cut off funding for South Africa
nacbebd0ac5.summary: President Donald Trump said he would cut off funding for South Africa until an investigation is held, citing without evidence claims that certain classes of people are being treated badly.
nacbebd0ac5.why: US aid and funding decisions affect South Africa's public programs and bilateral economic relations, with implications for investors in the country.

nf31e813b7b.headline: KSE-100 loses over 1,500 points in line with global markets
nf31e813b7b.summary: The Pakistan Stock Exchange's benchmark KSE-100 index saw selling pressure on Monday and closed sharply lower. The decline was in line with global markets.
nf31e813b7b.why: The KSE-100 is the benchmark index of the Pakistan Stock Exchange in Karachi, tracking the country's largest listed companies.
nf31e813b7b.why_moved: The index fell on selling pressure on the exchange, in line with global markets, according to the report.

nc105119d78.headline: AstraZeneca cancels £450m investment in UK after dispute over Government support
nc105119d78.summary: AstraZeneca said the Labour government failed to match its predecessor's offer of help for the Merseyside investment, and it cancelled the £450m project. The company blamed the government support dispute.
nc105119d78.why: AstraZeneca is a major UK-listed pharmaceutical group, and its investment decisions affect the UK life sciences sector.

n4bec40428b.headline: Trudeau says U.S. tariffs on Canada will be paused for 30 days
n4bec40428b.summary: US President Donald Trump agreed not to impose tariffs on Canada and Mexico for another month. The pause pulled back from a plan that would have started a North American trade war.
n4bec40428b.why: Canada and the United States are each other's largest trading partners, so tariff decisions directly affect trade flows and currencies.
n4bec40428b.why_moved: Trump agreed to hold off tariffs on Canada and Mexico for a month, avoiding an immediate trade war.

n8580d73fb9.headline: ALPi reaffirms commitment to AfCFTA, driving Africa’s trade and infrastructure growth
n8580d73fb9.summary: Sales of pure electric used cars in the UK reached a record market share last year, with about 188,000 vehicles changing hands in 2024, according to SMMT figures.
n8580d73fb9.why: The SMMT is the UK's motor industry trade body, and used EV volumes indicate the pace of electric vehicle adoption across the car market.

n6836cec2de.headline: U.S. stock futures plummet after Trump hits U.S. trading partners with tariffs
n6836cec2de.summary: Futures tied to the Dow Jones Industrial Average fell 463 points, or 1%, while S&P 500 futures dropped 1.6% and Nasdaq-100 futures lost 2.1%. The decline followed Trump's tariff announcement.
n6836cec2de.why: US equity index futures track expected opening moves in the Dow, S&P 500 and Nasdaq, so they are a closely watched gauge of market sentiment. Tariffs can raise costs for importers and exporters and hit corporate earnings.

n04c53a3c89.headline: Trump attack on South Africa exposes divisions over race and land
n04c53a3c89.summary: Ramaphosa defended his land reform policy against Trump's attack, which said without citing evidence that South Africa is confiscating land. The dispute exposes racial divisions over land ownership.
n04c53a3c89.why: South Africa is a major African economy, and its relations with the US affect trade and investment. Land reform is a politically sensitive issue for investors assessing policy risk.

na27c07dc88.headline: Wall Street swings after Trump announces tariffs then puts some on hold
na27c07dc88.summary: US stocks pared their losses after Mexican President Claudia Sheinbaum said tariffs on her country's goods were on hold for a month. The index had swung as tariff announcements shifted.
na27c07dc88.why: The S&P 500 tracks 500 large US companies and is the main gauge of US equity performance. Its moves reflect expectations for trade policy, corporate earnings and growth.
na27c07dc88.why_moved: Trump announced tariffs and then paused some of them after Mexico's president said tariffs on Mexican goods were on hold for a month. Stocks recovered part of their losses on that news.

n4d3c74c4a2.headline: Trade war fears spook markets; Sensex falls 319 points
n4d3c74c4a2.summary: The BSE Sensex fell 319 points as trade war fears spooked markets. Larsen & Toubro, Tata Motors, Hindustan Unilever and Reliance Industries were among the major laggards, while Bajaj Finance jumped over 5%.
n4d3c74c4a2.why: The Sensex tracks 30 large companies listed on the Bombay Stock Exchange and is India's benchmark equity index. It reflects domestic and global sentiment toward Indian corporate earnings.
n4d3c74c4a2.why_moved: Trade war fears spooked investors, and the Sensex fell 319 points with major blue-chip laggards including Larsen & Toubro and Reliance Industries.

n068c8d79f9.headline: ‘Expropriation Act will create development opportunities’
n068c8d79f9.summary: Developers believe the new Expropriation Act could stimulate economic activity and create development opportunities. The legislation governs the state's power to take private property.
n068c8d79f9.why: Expropriation laws define how governments can take property and compensate owners, which affects land values, property investment and foreign investor confidence. South Africa is a major African economy.

na952082416.headline: Nasdaq, S&P 500 pare losses, US agrees to one-month tariff pause
na952082416.summary: Nasdaq and S&P 500 pared losses after the United States and Canada sidestepped a potential tariff war, at least for now. The US agreed to a one-month tariff pause.
na952082416.why: The S&P 500 tracks large US listed companies, and tariff decisions affect trade costs and earnings outlooks across many sectors.

impacts.name: S&P 500
impacts.why: A tariff pause reduces the near-term risk of a trade war that had weighed on US equities.
impacts.baseline_rule: first recorded price at or after created_at (15-minute price recorder); end = first price at least 24 h later, within 48 h

na952082416.why_moved: The one-month US tariff pause with Canada reduced immediate trade-war fears, so US indexes recovered part of their losses.

n98043dc33b.headline: Factory activity falls again as rising costs and weak demand hit manufacturers
n98043dc33b.summary: UK factory activity fell again, with new orders and jobs declining across the board. Firms warned that a weak economic outlook is hitting small factories hardest.
n98043dc33b.why: Manufacturing surveys are early indicators of economic momentum, and weak factory data shapes expectations for Bank of England policy.

n5eaac5a8a6.headline: Stocks drop, dollar rallies as Year of the Snake starts with bite
n5eaac5a8a6.summary: Stock markets in Asia and Europe sank and the dollar surged after Donald Trump signed off tariffs on China, Canada and Mexico. He warned the European Union would be hit soon.
n5eaac5a8a6.why: Tariffs on major trading partners raise global trade costs, and a stronger dollar tightens financial conditions for emerging markets and exporters.
n5eaac5a8a6.why_moved: New US tariffs on China, Canada and Mexico raised trade-war fears, driving investors into the dollar and out of Asian and European stocks.

n799af86c8f.headline: Zenith Energy closes GBP2.9 million placement, settles debts
n799af86c8f.summary: Zenith Energy completed a private placement in Norway worth GBP2.9 million and a debt settlement, with participation from its chief executive.
n799af86c8f.why: Zenith Energy is a small oil and gas company with assets in Africa and Italy, and capital raises fund its exploration and debt position.

nefbe72dc68.headline: Aussie households forecast to weather Trump tariffs
nefbe72dc68.summary: Australia may see some fallout from Donald Trump's tariffs on Mexican and Canadian imports, but local households are expected to cope. The outlook was reported by a regional news outlet.
nefbe72dc68.why: US tariff policy affects global trade flows, commodity demand and currencies, which feed into Australia's export-heavy economy and household finances.

ncbacf053b1.headline: Government’s consumption growth estimated to improve in FY25
ncbacf053b1.summary: A report estimates government consumption growth will improve in FY25 on higher revenue expenditure by state and union governments. Private consumption is expected to be driven by rural demand and easing inflation.
ncbacf053b1.why: Government and private consumption are major components of India's GDP, so their trajectory shapes growth expectations for Asia's large economies and the rupee.

naaa27cf57d.headline: Trump Halts Canadian Tariffs as Trudeau Appoints ‘Fentanyl Czar’
naaa27cf57d.summary: Canada will send 10,000 frontline personnel to the northern border, a move that mirrors what Mexico did earlier Monday. The announcement accompanied a halt to US tariffs on Canadian goods.
naaa27cf57d.why: Canada is the largest trading partner of the United States, so tariff changes between the two countries affect cross-border supply chains, autos, energy and agriculture.
naaa27cf57d.why_moved: Pausing tariffs on Canadian imports reduces near-term trade-policy risk for companies that rely on cross-border trade.

n86c645813a.headline: UPL shares jump 5% on Q3 beat, Investec gives Rs 700 target price
n86c645813a.summary: UPL shares rose 5% to Rs 636.45 on strong Q3 results, driven by agrochemical demand recovery. Investec upgraded the stock to buy with a Rs 700 target, and management expects 50% YoY EBITDA growth.
n86c645813a.why: UPL is an Indian agrochemical company with global operations, and its results reflect crop-protection demand and input pricing.

n6c2164b8ea.headline: Nuvini Group Limited Reports Strong Growth in First Half 2024 Results
n6c2164b8ea.summary: Nuvini Group reported first half 2024 results, with adjusted EBITDA up 25% and improved operating profitability. The company describes itself as an acquirer of private SaaS B2B companies in Latin America.
n6c2164b8ea.why: Nuvini is a software-as-a-service acquirer focused on Latin American businesses, so its results indicate performance in the region's small-cap software sector.

n12a1c0bfc4.headline: Wall Street swerves lower after Trump announces tariffs and then puts some on hold
n12a1c0bfc4.summary: US stocks swung between sharp and modest losses as global markets fell on concerns that Trump's tariffs could ignite a damaging trade war. Some of the tariffs were then put on hold.
n12a1c0bfc4.why: The S&P 500 tracks 500 large US companies and is the main gauge of US equity performance. Tariff announcements feed directly into trade costs, inflation expectations and corporate earnings outlooks.
n12a1c0bfc4.why_moved: Trump announced tariffs and then put some on hold, while investors worried about a trade war that could hit company profits and global growth.

ne2f6b2b285.headline: European leaders warn of pain from transatlantic trade war
ne2f6b2b285.summary: European leaders warned that Trump's threat to expand tariffs to the EU risked setting off a trade war. The warning came in Brussels.
ne2f6b2b285.why: The EU is one of the largest trading blocs with the US, so tariffs affect European exporters, the euro and equity markets. Investors watch these trade tensions closely.

n1e16fd556a.headline: U.S. stock market recovers some ground on hopes for a trade-war reprieve
n1e16fd556a.summary: Wall Street plunged and then recovered some ground after President Trump said he would delay at least part of his promised global trade war. The swings reflected tariff whiplash among investors.
n1e16fd556a.why: The S&P 500 tracks 500 large US listed companies and is the main gauge of US equity performance. Tariff policy shifts directly affect the earnings outlook of exporters and importers.
n1e16fd556a.why_moved: Investors reacted to tariff uncertainty, selling sharply before recovering after Trump signaled a delay to part of the trade war. Relief over a possible reprieve supported the rebound.

nea8f85e805.headline: Business Rundown: U.S. Escalates Towards Trade War
nea8f85e805.summary: US tariffs on Canada, Mexico and China have been signed and are set to take effect Tuesday. Mexico was the first to meet President Trump's demands, according to the report.
nea8f85e805.why: Tariffs raise the cost of imported goods and can disrupt supply chains, trade flows and company margins across North American and Chinese trade.
nea8f85e805.why_moved: The tariffs on three major trading partners raise trade-war risk, which weighs on trade-exposed assets and companies. The input does not specify index moves.

n319d2af998.headline: Markets partially recover after Trump delays Mexico tariffs
n319d2af998.summary: Markets partially recovered after Trump agreed to pause tariffs on Mexico following a call with the Mexican president. Tariffs on Canada and China were announced at the same time.
n319d2af998.why: Tariff announcements affect trade-exposed companies and currencies, so pauses or reversals can quickly move equity and FX markets.
n319d2af998.why_moved: A pause on tariffs for Mexico eased trade-war fears after the initial announcement, helping markets recover part of their losses.

n375a1ba68d.headline: The EU cheers, but Mexico fears, their new trade accord. Why? Donald Trump.
n375a1ba68d.summary: Brussels is celebrating a new trade accord, while Mexico, exposed to US tariffs, has reason to stay quiet, according to the report.
n375a1ba68d.why: Trade agreements between major blocs reshape export access, and Mexico's dependence on US trade makes it sensitive to US tariff policy.

nef14a37e60.headline: EU Vows Trade Retaliation With Tusk Slamming ‘Stupid Tariff War’
nef14a37e60.summary: European Council President Donald Tusk criticised the US tariffs as a stupid tariff war, and the EU vowed to retaliate. The dispute is part of Bloomberg's ongoing coverage of global trade.
nef14a37e60.why: The European Union is one of the largest trading blocs, and retaliatory tariffs can hit exporters, supply chains and cross-border investment.
nef14a37e60.why_moved: The EU has vowed to retaliate against US tariffs, and Tusk criticised the trade war. Escalating trade tensions raise concerns for exporters and global growth.

nc9e1af070c.headline: IDEXX Laboratories Announces Fourth Quarter and Full Year 2024 Results
nc9e1af070c.summary: IDEXX Laboratories reported fourth-quarter revenue growth of 6% as reported and on an organic basis. CAG Diagnostics recurring revenue rose 6% reported and 7% organic.
nc9e1af070c.why: IDEXX is a US maker of veterinary diagnostic tests and instruments, and its results signal demand for animal healthcare and diagnostics.

n49f941bfb0.headline: FBR using agriculture tax as excuse to hide failures: CM Sindh
n49f941bfb0.summary: The Sindh chief minister said the Federal Board of Revenue is using agriculture tax as an excuse to hide failures. He reiterated that Prime Minister Shehbaz had acknowledged deep-rooted corruption at the FBR.
n49f941bfb0.why: The Federal Board of Revenue is Pakistan's tax authority, and disputes over tax collection shape the government's fiscal position and its ability to meet IMF-linked targets.

nc842d145e1.headline: Danish leader seeks support from EU partners over Trump’s Greenland threats
nc842d145e1.summary: Danish Prime Minister Mette Frederiksen is seeking support from EU partners over Trump's threats concerning Greenland, insisting the territory is part of Denmark and 'not for sale'.
nc842d145e1.why: Greenland is an autonomous territory within the Kingdom of Denmark, and its strategic and resource significance makes its status a matter of geopolitical and economic interest.

n8502a9312c.headline: Euro zone inflation rises to hotter-than-expected 2.5% in January on energy price hike
n8502a9312c.summary: Euro zone inflation rose to 2.5% in January, above the 2.4% forecast by economists polled by Reuters. The increase was driven by an energy price hike.
n8502a9312c.why: Inflation data shapes European Central Bank interest rate decisions, which affect bond yields and the euro. Energy prices feed directly into headline inflation.
n8502a9312c.why_moved: The reading came in above economists' expectations, driven by higher energy prices, which can shift expectations for European interest rates.

n43649c30ca.headline: Aurangzeb confident as Pakistan awaits IMF review
n43649c30ca.summary: Finance Minister Muhammad Aurangzeb expressed confidence in government progress toward meeting International Monetary Fund requirements as Pakistan awaits an IMF review.
n43649c30ca.why: IMF reviews determine whether Pakistan receives loan tranches that support its balance of payments and reserves.

nc790ab6981.headline: Budget 2025-26 maintains high Capex amid fiscal prudence: BoB analysis
nc790ab6981.summary: Bank of Baroda economists say the 2025-26 Union Budget maintained fiscal prudence and high capital expenditure. They describe the government's stable borrowing programme as positive for markets.
nc790ab6981.why: India's Union Budget sets fiscal deficit and borrowing targets that influence government bond yields and the rupee.

na8cc869dcc.headline: President Trump Signs Order To Create Sovereign Wealth Fund
na8cc869dcc.summary: President Trump signed an order to create a sovereign wealth fund. The report describes the move as a significant shift in U.S. economic strategy.
na8cc869dcc.why: Sovereign wealth funds invest state assets in equities, bonds and private holdings, which can affect capital flows and markets.

na54aa12b1a.headline: Volkswagen moves HC over $1.4 bn tax notice
na54aa12b1a.summary: Skoda Auto Volkswagen India has filed a case against tax authorities over an Rs 11,000 crore show-cause notice for alleged customs duty fraud on imported CKD cars.
na54aa12b1a.why: Volkswagen is a global carmaker, and its Skoda brand sells in India, where tax disputes can affect costs and profits.

n87f70b4d40.headline: Over 9-year low: Inflation in Pakistan clocks in at 2.4% in January 2025
n87f70b4d40.summary: Pakistan's headline inflation clocked in at 2.4% year on year in January 2025, a reading described as an over nine-year low.
n87f70b4d40.why: Inflation data guides central bank rate decisions and shapes the purchasing power and investment climate of an economy.

n964ef1c567.headline: President Trump Signs Order To Create Sovereign Wealth Fund
n964ef1c567.summary: President Trump signed an order to establish a sovereign wealth fund. The description says the move marks a significant shift in the U.S. economic strategy.
n964ef1c567.why: A sovereign wealth fund is a state-owned investment vehicle that can deploy public capital into equities, bonds and strategic assets, so its design shapes government investment flows.

n807baa719c.headline: How will wage hikes impact businesses? Economist breaks down the data
n807baa719c.summary: An economist examines whether businesses can absorb a proposed P200 increase in daily minimum wages for Philippine workers. The analysis focuses on the data behind the wage hike.
n807baa719c.why: Minimum wage changes affect labor costs for employers and household spending power, which matter for Philippine retail, manufacturing and services firms.

nb698b11ee3.headline: Kaffeepreis bei Tchibo wieder gestiegen
nb698b11ee3.summary: German coffee retailer Tchibo has raised its coffee prices again because of tight raw coffee supplies and weak harvests. The company cites these factors for the price increase.
nb698b11ee3.why: Coffee prices depend on raw bean supply from producing regions, and poor harvests feed through to roasters and retail prices.

n8d8942b015.headline: DA declares food security emergency
n8d8942b015.summary: Agriculture Secretary Francisco Tiu Laurel Jr. declared a food security emergency on rice on February 3, 2025, amid an extraordinary increase in prices.
n8d8942b015.why: Rice is a staple food in the Philippines, and government emergency measures on supply and prices affect inflation, import policy and food companies.

nd7a2bd2d5a.headline: Europe reacts to Trump tariffs on Mexico, Canada, China
nd7a2bd2d5a.summary: US President Donald Trump has ordered sweeping tariffs on goods from Mexico, Canada and China, demanding they curb issues the article describes; European reaction followed.
nd7a2bd2d5a.why: US tariffs raise costs for imports and can trigger retaliation, disrupting supply chains and trade flows across North America, Asia and Europe.
nd7a2bd2d5a.why_moved: New US tariffs on imports from Mexico, Canada and China raise trade costs and increase uncertainty for exporters in those markets.

n81be8f62ad.headline: Ontario PCs pledge billions in stimulus that would flow after election if tariffs hit
n81be8f62ad.summary: Ontario Progressive Conservative Leader Doug Ford has pledged billions in stimulus that would flow after the snap election if tariffs hit the province.
n81be8f62ad.why: Ontario is Canada's largest provincial economy, so its fiscal policy and response to tariffs affect manufacturing and trade-exposed industries.

nf55dfb0784.headline: UN begins talks toward 'fair' tax accord without US
nf55dfb0784.summary: The United Nations has begun talks toward a fair tax accord that excludes the United States. The negotiations aim to set a broader framework for taxing multinational income.
nf55dfb0784.why: Global tax coordination affects multinational companies' effective tax rates and the rules governing cross-border profit allocation.

n79170f9b41.headline: DA declares food security emergency to curb rising rice prices
n79170f9b41.summary: The Department of Agriculture has declared a food security emergency in response to rising rice costs. Rice has reached P50 to P60 per kilo, according to the input.
n79170f9b41.why: Rice is the Philippines' staple food, so rising prices feed directly into domestic inflation and household budgets.

n488edc8ab9.headline: Global hedge funds dump everything but real estate stocks, says Goldman Sachs
n488edc8ab9.summary: Hedge funds last week sold global stocks and added bets on declines, Goldman Sachs said. The move came just before Trump announced tariffs that sent global markets tumbling.
n488edc8ab9.why: Hedge fund positioning is tracked by prime brokers such as Goldman Sachs and signals how professional money is reacting to trade and policy risk.

nbee0264afc.headline: Germany must address structural weaknesses to keep AAA rating, Scope says
nbee0264afc.summary: Scope Ratings says weaker GDP growth alone does not pose an immediate threat to Germany's AAA rating. Structural weaknesses must be overcome to keep the rating in the long term.
nbee0264afc.why: Sovereign credit ratings influence borrowing costs for governments, and Germany's AAA rating underpins the benchmark euro area bond market.

ne1672123e4.headline: Rupee records marginal decline against US dollar
ne1672123e4.summary: The Pakistani rupee settled at 279.04 against the US dollar in the inter-bank market. The move was a marginal decline.
ne1672123e4.why: The rupee's exchange rate against the dollar affects import costs and inflation in Pakistan.

n68e9882276.headline: BT rings changes at BT Business with new boss | RCR Wireless
n68e9882276.summary: BT Business has hired Jon James from Danish telecoms provider Nuuday as its new chief executive, with a brief to fully focus on the UK.
n68e9882276.why: BT Group is the UK's largest telecom provider, and its business unit serves corporate and public-sector customers. Leadership changes can signal strategic priorities for the division.

ne19d6bed9e.headline: Taoiseach urges caution in EU response to Trump tariff threat
ne19d6bed9e.summary: Taoiseach Micheal Martin urged caution in the European Union's response to a tariff threat from U.S. President Donald Trump.
ne19d6bed9e.why: The EU and the United States are major trading partners, and tariff escalation affects exporters across Europe. Ireland has a large export base, particularly in pharmaceuticals and technology.

n35ca731304.headline: Nagy: Germany's success is important for Hungary
n35ca731304.summary: Hungarian minister Nagy said Germany has been in recession for two years and its economy is expected to continue contracting this year. He said Germany's success matters for Hungary.
n35ca731304.why: Germany is the euro area's largest economy and a major trading partner for Hungary and other European exporters, so its growth outlook shapes regional demand and corporate earnings.

ndbe0304488.headline: Menczer: Viktor Orbán has fought it out; the EU funds are coming to Hungary
ndbe0304488.summary: Hungarian minister Tamás Menczer said Prime Minister Viktor Orbán has already secured 12.5 billion euros in EU funds and the rest will also come.
ndbe0304488.why: EU cohesion and recovery funds are a major source of public investment in Hungary, and their release affects government spending and the forint outlook.

n9d18d6b14d.headline: Euronext upgraded from ‘BBB+, Positive Outlook‘ to ‘A-, Stable Outlook‘ by S&P
n9d18d6b14d.summary: S&P has upgraded Euronext from BBB+ with a positive outlook to A- with a stable outlook. Euronext operates exchanges in Amsterdam, Brussels, Dublin, Lisbon, Milan, Oslo and Paris.
n9d18d6b14d.why: Euronext is Europe's largest stock exchange operator, and its credit rating affects its borrowing costs and investor confidence.

na59d5d65a3.headline: UK will ‘stay resolute’ in commitment to working with US and EU, says Starmer
na59d5d65a3.summary: UK Prime Minister Keir Starmer said the UK will stay resolute in its commitment to working with the US and EU. The prospect of a trade war with the US has loomed over his trip to Brussels.
na59d5d65a3.why: The UK trades heavily with both the US and the EU, so tariff disputes affect exporters, sterling and the wider outlook for British growth.

n3648047edf.headline: Indonesia’s January inflation at 0.76% y/y: statistics bureau
n3648047edf.summary: Indonesia's inflation rate was 0.76% in January, down sharply from 1.57% in December and below the lower bound of the central bank's target range, official data showed.
n3648047edf.why: Inflation data guides Bank Indonesia's interest rate decisions, which influence the rupiah, bond yields and domestic borrowing costs.

n2742dee9b0.headline: Goldman Sachs flags up to 3% hit to its S&P 500 earnings forecasts from Trump's tariffs
n2742dee9b0.summary: Goldman Sachs economists estimate that if the latest tariffs announced by President Trump are sustained, they could cut S&P 500 earnings forecasts by up to 3%.
n2742dee9b0.why: The S&P 500 is the main US equity benchmark, and changes to earnings forecasts influence valuations and investor expectations for corporate profits.

impacts.name: S&P 500
impacts.why: Goldman estimates tariffs could reduce S&P 500 earnings forecasts by up to 3 percent.

naaabd0aa23.headline: Pound rises against euro after Trump hints UK may avoid tariffs
naaabd0aa23.summary: Sterling slid against the dollar but rose against the euro on Monday as the greenback rallied after the U.S. imposed tariffs on Canada, Mexico and China. Trump's comments on UK tariffs supported the pound.
naaabd0aa23.why: Sterling is the currency of the United Kingdom, and its exchange rates feed into trade costs, inflation and asset prices. Tariff news changes the outlook for UK exports.
naaabd0aa23.why_moved: Sterling gained against the euro after President Trump hinted the UK may avoid tariffs, while a rally in the dollar after new US tariffs on Canada, Mexico and China pushed it lower against the greenback.

nd3900ce415.headline: Trump pauses tariffs on Canada and Mexico. Here's why it matters to automakers
nd3900ce415.summary: Trump has paused tariffs on Canada and Mexico. Tariffs of 25%, if imposed, would be costly for buyers and the auto industry, which relies on a North American supply chain.
nd3900ce415.why: The auto industry moves parts across the US, Mexico and Canada, so tariffs on these countries raise production costs for automakers and suppliers.
nd3900ce415.why_moved: The pause removes the threat of 25% tariffs on Canadian and Mexican goods, which would have raised costs across the integrated North American auto supply chain.

n63e85bae2f.headline: Trump wrong, U.S. banks can and do operate in Canada, association and professor say
n63e85bae2f.summary: The Canadian Bankers Association says U.S. subsidiaries and branches account for half of all foreign bank assets in Canada. It disputes U.S. claims that American banks cannot operate in the country.
n63e85bae2f.why: Foreign bank subsidiaries and branches hold large shares of Canadian banking assets, so restrictions on them would matter to banks and to the financial system.

na44c692163.headline: B.C. has pulled red state liquor from the shelves in response to Trump's tariff
na44c692163.summary: Liquor from U.S. Republican-led states has been removed from British Columbia store shelves. Premier David Eby promised the measure as retaliation against U.S. tariffs.
na44c692163.why: Provincial liquor retailers are state-controlled in Canada, so decisions on U.S. alcohol supply directly affect cross-border beverage trade.

nb8a37f5d63.headline: American tariffs will hit oats from Yorkton processor
nb8a37f5d63.summary: Oats from a Yorkton, Saskatchewan processor will be hit by American tariffs. Trump signed an order on Saturday imposing the tariffs.
nb8a37f5d63.why: Canada is a major oat exporter, and tariffs on Canadian grain products raise costs for processors that sell into the U.S.
